lenses.st: Wonderful business at a fair price

lenses.vd: In Warren Buffett's spirit: a great business, and the price passes both this lens's own price test and the fair-value check (₹525 vs fair value ₹761).

ch.r: No loss in 10 years
ch.w: No loss in the years we can see.
